schema.title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0: version number
schema.description: A normal version number MUST take the form X.Y.Z where X, Y, and Z are non-negative integers (item 2), optionally followed by a pre-release (item 9) and build metadata (item 10).

preRelease.description: A series of dot separated identifiers following a hyphen. Identifiers MUST comprise only ASCII alphanumerics and hyphen [0-9A-Za-z-] and MUST NOT be empty. Numeric identifiers MUST NOT include leading zeroes (item 9).

buildMetadata.description: A series of dot separated identifiers following a plus sign. Identifiers MUST comprise only ASCII alphanumerics and hyphen [0-9A-Za-z-] and MUST NOT be empty (item 10).
